turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. Owen's grade shows a zero on his Hamlet essay, and nobody called me before it went in. What happened?
Don't thank me yet. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
Okay. Walk me through it, and be specific. Which document, and what dates are on it?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You told me you wanted to walk me through what you found in the version history, but you never gave me a document or a date. I still require that the zero be withdrawn, that nothing go on Owen's record, and that you send me the version history in writing. I expect all of it in my inbox by Wednesday, November 11, and if I don't have it I am going to the principal.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
